profile.name: DHAMODHARAN R
profile.title: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER & AI/ML ENGINEER
profile.bio: Pre-final-year Computer Science and Engineering student at Achariya College of Engineering Technology with a strong academic record (CGPA: 9.05/10) and hands-on experience in software development, AI/ML applications, and IoT-based systems. Skilled in Java, Python, JavaScript, C, C++, and MySQL, with practical experience in developing web applications, database-driven solutions, and intelligent monitoring systems. Strong foundation in Data Structures and Algorithms, Database Management Systems, Object-Oriented Programming, and software development principles. Passionate about solving real-world problems through technology and seeking an entry-level Software Developer opportunity to apply technical skills and contribute to innovative application development.

projects.title: NIVORA – Smart Intelligent Mountain Road Safety System
projects.description: Developed an IoT-based road safety solution to detect approaching vehicles at blind curves and reduce accident risks. Implemented bidirectional alerts, GPS-based emergency SOS functionality, and fail-safe mechanisms for communication and power failures.

projects.title: ZERORA – Advanced Water Monitoring & Automatic Cleaning System
projects.description: Developed an intelligent water monitoring solution using pH, turbidity, and TDS sensors. Implemented real-time contamination detection, automatic cleaning mechanisms, and alert notifications for water-quality management.

projects.title: INOROUT – Real-Time Smart Faculty Availability & Notification System
projects.description: Developed a system to track faculty availability using real-time entry/exit sensor detection and a web platform for managing departmental communication. Implemented sensor-based monitoring to update status automatically and designed an accessible notification interface to inform students about faculty presence.

projects.title: DIGILOG – Digital Student Monitoring System
projects.description: Developed a digital platform to manage student academic records, attendance, assignments, and other activities. Implemented structured data management and automated record tracking to improve information accessibility and monitoring efficiency.

projects.title: CSENEXUS – Department Coordination Website
projects.description: Developed a web platform for managing departmental activities, announcements, and communication. Designed an accessible user interface to improve information sharing between students and faculty members.

projects.title: Athlete Stress Management System Using AI/ML
projects.description: Developed an AI/ML-based application to analyze athlete stress levels and identify stress-related patterns. Applied machine learning techniques to support early identification of stress-related concerns and data-driven analysis.

projects.title: Smart Laboratory Management System
projects.description: Developed a digital laboratory management system to organize laboratory resources and records. Implemented structured resource management to improve accessibility and reduce manual administrative activities.

projects.title: AQUANEST – Smart Water Management System
projects.description: Developed an automated pond cleaning and water-quality management system. Integrated sensors and automated mechanisms to monitor pond conditions and reduce manual cleaning efforts. Implemented a dashboard to display real-time water-quality monitoring results and sensor readings, enabling centralized visualization of pond conditions to support effective monitoring and management.

projects.title: CODE BREAKERZ – Technical Symposium Event Website
projects.description: Developed a dedicated website for a national-level technical symposium. Implemented event information, registration features, and responsive interfaces to improve participant communication and event management.

experience.description: Contributed to the development and implementation of AI/ML-based software applications. Applied machine learning concepts, analytical thinking, and software engineering principles to practical development tasks. Collaborated with engineers and team members to design, develop, and improve application functionality.

Developed web pages and user interface components using web development tools and technologies. Explored frontend–backend integration, application routing, and project architecture. Gained practical exposure to website development, application workflows, and deployment concepts.
